name: Imouto ~Mitsutsubo: Dai Nishou~
original_name: いもうと ～蜜壺・第二章～
source:
Tooru, the main character, returns home for the first time in a while and reunites with Mitsuka, his younger sister, who has grown into a beautiful woman. 

"A feeling rekindled in my heart when I saw her. But also a deep sadness. I remember the guilt of lusting after my own sister. I left my hometown because of it and decided to love another woman. I was supposed to have come to announce my engagement with Saori... but my resolve is shattered by my sister's sweet temptation."

Half a year has passed since then... but Mitsuka still loves him.

"I want to meet him, hear his voice, touch his skin...I want to be loved by my brother...''

A story of love, hate, and desire unfolds in a snowy countryside painted white.
translation:
主人公彻很久以来第一次回到家，与已经长成美丽女性的妹妹美塚重逢。

“看到她时，我心中重新燃起了某种感情，却也感到深深的悲伤。我记得曾对亲妹妹产生欲望的罪恶感，因此离开故乡，决定爱上另一个女人。本来应该回来宣布与沙织订婚……但妹妹甜蜜的诱惑击碎了我的决心。”

半年过去了……但美塚仍然爱着他。

“我想见他，听他的声音，触摸他的肌肤……我想被哥哥爱……”

一段关于爱、恨与欲望的故事，在白雪皑皑的乡间展开。
